role: exploratory R08 development; not independent confirmation
hypothesis: Dense causal windows that include transitions may improve continuous command quality relative to cue-centered window training.
model: EEGNet8 transfer recipe; no architecture change

source.subjects: 89 eligible source participants from S016-S109 per configs/gpu_research.json

dense_windows.label: instruction state at causal window endpoint
dense_windows.sampling: balanced binary class sampling; sample an episode uniformly within class before sampling a window
dense_windows.optimizer_update_budget: matched per epoch to the cue-window recipe; source count from all source R04/R08 cue windows, target count from target R04 cue windows

evaluation.aggregation: average training seeds within each participant, then summarize 15 participant means

limitations: R08 was development data and is not fresh confirmation.
All eligible source participants contributed to source training or validation; target R12 had prior historical inspection.
Endpoint instruction labels do not establish neural-intent onset.
No robot rollouts were run for this training ablation.
